taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: Aiyo, the quota is 80 invoices a day but trainer earlier said 50 for first month. Last week had to OT until 9pm three times to hit, then rush-rush make more mistakes la.
What support or adjustment would help with the invoice quota?
If can give proper ramp-up quota for first 2 months would really help la. That way don't need to rush so much and can reduce mistakes.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reported a discrepancy between the daily invoice quota and initial training guidance, requiring multiple overtime shifts to meet targets.
